description: For a continuous multi-span office floor designed under Part 4, our live-load analysis would load every span simultaneously and stop there. We would not check any partial-area loading patterns even where they could produce a larger effect in a member. We want to use this simplified loading method in the submission.
known_facts: partial-area patterns omitted even if they are more critical

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: Only full-area live loading is considered rather than the full or partial loading producing the most critical member effects.
gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
